description: Changes a song mixed from stems the way the person asks after listening. Per stem: volume, mute, position (left to right), reverb (space), stereo width, tone (brightness, body, mids, low cut, air, high cut), punch, drive (warmth or crunch), chorus, phaser, flanger, tremolo and echo. Only what a change names is changed; everything else on the stem stays as it is. Every value replaces the current one, so start from the settings get_song_status shows (with the stem ids and file names) for "a bit more" or "less". A position or width for a stem that cannot be moved or widened (canMove, canWiden) is refused. One call takes all the changes for a song. The changes are heard in the next mix, which Bandmixr makes with the master right away: quick when the song needs no new draft, about as long as the first mix when it does (a reverb Bandmixr cannot turn on that stem, or a stem placed the older way). The studio shows the progress and plays the new version, which replaces the earlier version made in the chat (downloaded versions and mixes made on the website stay).

chorus.description: Chorus: a thicker, shimmering double. About 0.2 is a little, 0.5 clearly, 0.8 a lot; 0 removes it.

drive.description: Drive (saturation): warm = gentle "Warmth" (the Simple view's word), crunch = audible distortion. About 0.2 is a little, 0.5 clearly, 0.8 a lot; 0 removes it.

echo.description: Echo (delay): slapback = one short echo, needs no tempo; eighth, dotted (dotted eighths), quarter and pingPong (bounces left and right) follow the song's tempo, so the song needs one. About 0.2 is a little, 0.5 clearly, 0.8 a lot; 0 removes it.

flanger.description: Flanger: a jet-like sweep. About 0.2 is a little, 0.5 clearly, 0.8 a lot; 0 removes it.

muted.description: true = leave the stem out of the mix; false = bring it back.

anyOf.description: Where the stem sits from left to right: -1 hard left, 0 center, 1 hard right, or "auto" for where Bandmixr places it. "A bit to the left" is about -0.2 to -0.3, "left" about -0.6. It replaces the current value (get_song_status shows it).

pan.description: Where the stem sits from left to right: -1 hard left, 0 center, 1 hard right, or "auto" for where Bandmixr places it. "A bit to the left" is about -0.2 to -0.3. The plain words "left", "center" and "right" are taken as -0.6, 0 and 0.6. It replaces the current value (get_song_status shows it).

phaser.description: Phaser: a sweeping, swirling sound. About 0.2 is a little, 0.5 clearly, 0.8 a lot; 0 removes it.

punch.description: Punch: more attack and impact, for drums, bass, rhythm parts. About 0.2 is a little, 0.5 clearly, 0.8 a lot; 0 removes it.

reverb.description: Reverb, the "Space" of the Simple view, against the reverb Bandmixr gave the stem: default = Bandmixr's own; none = dry; low = about half; medium = about one and a half times; high = a lot (the most).

tone.description: Tone (EQ). Name only the parts that change; 0 takes a part away.

air.description: Air: shine and sparkle at the very top. About 0.2 is a little, 0.5 clearly, 0.8 a lot; 0 removes it.

highCut.description: High cut: takes away the top, darker and softer. About 0.2 is a little, 0.5 clearly, 0.8 a lot; 0 removes it.

highs.description: Highs, the "Brightness": -1 darker and duller to 1 brighter and crisper. 0 = as Bandmixr made it.

lowCut.description: Low cut: takes away low end and rumble. About 0.2 is a little, 0.5 clearly, 0.8 a lot; 0 removes it.

lows.description: Lows, the "Body" of the website's Simple view: -1 thinner to 1 fuller. 0 = as Bandmixr made it.

mids.description: Mids: -1 less to 1 more presence in the middle (boxy, nasal, honky). 0 = as Bandmixr made it.

tremolo.description: Tremolo: the volume pulses. About 0.2 is a little, 0.5 clearly, 0.8 a lot; 0 removes it.

volumeDb.description: The stem's new level against Bandmixr's own balance in dB: 0 = Bandmixr's balance, +3 = 3 dB louder, -6 = 6 dB quieter. It replaces the current value (get_song_status shows it). So "a bit louder" from +2 is +4. About 1 to 2 dB is "a bit", 3 to 4 dB "clearly", 6 dB "a lot".

width.description: Stereo width against what Bandmixr made: 1 = as Bandmixr made it, 0 = mono, 2 = widest. "Wider" is about 1.3 to 1.5. It replaces the current value (get_song_status shows it).

songId.description: The song id from list_songs or create_song.

name: adjust_mix
title: Change the mix
